faq.question: Where is the DIP studio?
faq.answer: Birdcast has a studio in Dubai Investment Park suitable for podcasts, reels, interviews, branded content and production work.

faq.question: Can social content be recorded at the DIP studio?
faq.answer: Yes. The DIP studio can support social clips, branded content, podcast recordings and team shoots.

faq.question: Is the DIP studio suitable for companies?
faq.answer: Yes. The setup works for creators, companies, agencies, production teams and brand clients.

faq.question: Can I book the DIP studio online?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the booking button to choose a time for the Dubai Investment Park studio.

faq.question: Can I ask questions before booking?
faq.answer: Yes. Use WhatsApp for custom questions about the shoot, setup, guests, timing or content format.
